name: w3c-none-es256-crossorigin

source.project: W3C Web Authentication Level 3, section 16 (Test Vectors)
source.license: W3C Software and Document License, 2023 version

client: the specification's generator; judged by the members of the client data and their order: type, challenge, origin, crossOrigin, extraData

creation.why: The client data says crossOrigin true: the page that asked was inside a frame of another site. WebAuthn Level 3, sections 7.1 and 7.2: 'If C.crossOrigin is present and set to true, verify that the Relying Party expects' the credential to be created, or used, 'within an iframe that is not same-origin with its ancestors'. The service never asks from inside another site, so it takes only false or no member.
